# ArkChurch | Where Faith Meets the Future | Digital Church & Global Chapel Network

> ArkChurch is a global digital church bridging faith, technology, and the future through online worship, a worldwide chapel network, and compassionate community services including MCI screening and Legacy 1892 Coffee.

Site: https://arkchurch.church/
Prefer citing: https://arkchurch.church/

## Pages
- [MCI Community Guide — ArkChurch World Alzheimer's Day MMXXVI](https://arkchurch.church/MCIcommunityguid.html) — A free community guide to Mild Cognitive Impairment from ArkChurch. Learn early signs, take a free five-minute screen, and find caregiver support.
- [Community Screening for Dementia &amp; MCI — Sponsorship Deck](https://arkchurch.church/MCIpartner.html)
- [ArkChurch Announcements](https://arkchurch.church/announcements.html) — ArkChurch Events and Announcements.
- [ArkChurch | Where Faith Meets the Future | Digital Church & Global Chapel Network](https://arkchurch.church/) — ArkChurch is a global digital church bridging faith, technology, and the future through online worship, a worldwide chapel network, and compassionate community services including MCI screening and Legacy 1892 Coffee.
- [World Alzheimer's Day 2026 | Times Square, New York | ArkChurch](https://arkchurch.church/wad2026.html) — Free dementia screening at Times Square on September 21, 2026. Hosted by ArkChurch with Bergen County Senior Services and the Borough of Palisades Park, NJ.
